text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S suffered a major injury, so 
she was immediately treated in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Let's rest quietly for a while...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I... have a mission. ...There is... no 
time... to rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Just light work is fine. Please... 
give me permission to train."
choice_data_list:
For the sake of my mission, I should rest 
for now

If I judge that it's dangerous, I'll stop 
you immediately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list:
If that injury gets worse... you 
understand what that means, don't you?

If that injury gets worse... you know what 
that means, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Until it heals—I will rest 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. It seems even this much... 
still aches...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Symboli Kris S's injury has 
worsened. She stopped immediately and took 
time off to rest...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...With this level of load—it's no 
problem. Next—let's use the machines.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There will likely be delays to the plan. 
However—they should be kept to a minimum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Continuing with light training at this 
pace, Symboli Kris S made a smooth and 
successful comeback.
